messages:
jordan: heads up — thinking about a simpler download flow for audit bundles. current proposal: single signed manifest + chunked ndjson payloads behind a short-lived url. thoughts?
maya: love single manifest. makes retries deterministic. do we include per-item actor resolution or a mapping file?
sam: mapping file seems better for size. we can ship actor_id in each event and a actors.ndjson mapping id -> display_name, email, maybe pseudonym flag.
lee: agree on mapping. also we need a clear PII mode: full, pseudonymize, redact. console should show which was used in the export.
jordan: +1 to modes. UX note: in console, show a badge on the export row (PII: pseudonymized) and in the manifest metadata.
maya: quotas question — should exports consume the same quota bucket as API downloads or a separate export quota? large tenants will want controls.
sam: separate quota makes sense. we can count bytes read from the change stream for cost, and limit parallel downloads per-tenant. add a queued state for large exports.
jordan: implementation thought: export-service composes manifest, stores chunks in s3-like storage with presigned urls expiring in 24h, and emits an event to the tenant with manifest url.
lee: small security ask: include a signature over the manifest that can be verified by downstream tooling (HMAC with key per-tenant). prevents tampering if link leaked.
audit-bot: ExportTask[tid=ex-2024-07-05-8]: queued -> building_manifest (jordan)
maya: are we going to include an integrity checksum per chunk? we should for resumable downloads.
sam: yep: include sha256 for each chunk in the manifest. client can resume by comparing checksums.
jordan: debate: do we inline a small sample of events for quick preview in console (first 10 events) — helpful for quick quality check before download. privacy tradeoffs?
lee: preview should respect same PII mode as the export. and only show in console if user has "export_preview" permission.
maya: telemetry: we need metrics for export latency, manifest build time, chunking efficiency, ndjson size distribution, and failure reasons. also tag by PII mode and tenant tier.
sam: add an event for 'manifest_signed' and 'chunks_uploaded' so we can trace build vs upload time. also instrument actor-resolution cache hit rate.
jordan: API shape: GET /v1/audit-exports/{id}/manifest -> returns manifest json (signed), listing chunks like: [{"path": "chunks/1.ndjson.gz", "size": 12345, "sha256": ".."}, ...] and `actors` file url.
lee: keep manifest small — use urls, not embed lists. but include counts and sample hashes.
maya: rollout plan: beta with 3 tenants, feature-flagged, run for 2 weeks, collect telemetry. enable auto-retry for transient upload failures.
sam: ops note: we need alerts if manifest build > 10m or S3 put failures > 1% over 5m. capacity planning for concurrent builds.
jordan: ok action items: sam -> sketch manifest schema and presign flow, lee -> auth/signature design, maya -> console badges + preview permission, i'll own rollout plan and telemetry dashboard. i'll create a follow-up doc.
maya: SGTM. thanks! :party_parrot:
sam: thanks, will start a PR for schema.
